login.inAppBody: Google sign-in doesn't work here. Log in with email below, or open PronoHub in your browser (menu ⋮).
loadingMessages: The ref still has the ball, going to fetch it…
Checking if VAR approves the loading…
The server got nutmegged, it's on its way back…
Looking for the connection… it's hiding behind the defence.
Holding it up… like a target man back to goal.
Warming up: our servers are taking free kicks.
Waiting for the keeper to stop trash-talking.
Building a chance… just need to hit the target.
Playing it out from the back… loads better.
Kick-off in a moment… ref's promise.
Formation set: 4-4-2… 4 seconds, 4 bits of data, 2 coffees.
Passing the data around… loading tiki-taka.
